notes.title: v1.02 Update - Both English Version and Sale Go Live!
notes.content:
Updated to version 1.02 on 8/31 at 23:00 (JST).
You can finally play ●LIVE IN DUNGEON in English!
Stream and enjoy your adventure today!
To commemorate the English release, get your copy of the game 20% off the normal price!

In other news, the options screen has been updated and game pad compatibility has been greatly improved. Feedback regarding the controls have also been addressed!
We’ve also improved the screen display and fixed some minor bugs.

The details of the update are as follows.

・English version added.
・Improved UI, starting with the options screen.
・You can now choose from windowed and fullscreen screen settings.
・More screen resolution options have been added.
・You can now further customize key configurations.
・Improved accuracy for controller detection.
・Improved graphics when entering a battle.
・Fixed a bug with volume setting.
・Fixed errors in some monster names.

We look forward to seeing you ●LIVE!!

notes.title: v1.01 update: Improvement of Userbility
notes.content:
On 7:00pm 10th June(JST), we update LIVE IN DUNGEON to improve userbility.
English are not yet supported, but we will have created English version in a few months. please wait!

The details of this update are below:
-add a key mapping custormize system for keyboard.
-change initial key mapping.
-gamepads can be used.
You will need to enable the controller support settings in steam.
If this does not work properly, please try the recommended button assignments on steam.
-fix a few comments.
